vibe.verdict: A handsome black and white cabaret card with the right props, but the food and writing do not use the film's best known lines.
missing: 'Play it, Sam. Play 'As Time Goes By'' (Ilsa asks Sam at the piano)
'We'll always have Paris' (Rick and Ilsa at the airport)
'Of all the gin joints in all the towns in all the world' (Rick sees Ilsa)
The 'duel of the anthems', Die Wacht am Rhein drowned out by La Marseillaise
'Louis, I think this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship' (the fog, last scene)
Renault closing the cafe as he is 'shocked' by gambling, handed his winnings
ideas: Swap the 'Rick's runs the tables' tagline for 'Of all the gin joints', the line Rick says when Ilsa walks in.
Swap the cue to 'Pour the mint tea when Sam plays As Time Goes By for Ilsa' so it names the scene.
Swap the 'souk outside the doors' note on the lamb tagine for 'We'll always have Paris' and put the Paris gougères on the printed menu.
Swap the footer 'No discussing the letters of transit' for 'Round up the usual suspects' as the last line before the cue.
